# RIS-C

> Pure-Rust SPICE analog circuit simulation for embedding in Rust applications
> or invoking from any language through the spice CLI.

Use the `risc-c` package (`risc_c` in Rust) for a single dependency that includes
the circuit API and netlist runner. Git installation is documented; no registry
release or native numerical runtime is required. The CLI package is `risc-c-cli`
and the executable is `spice`.

## Integration

- [Agent integration brief](docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md): exact APIs, contracts, and implementation prompt.
- [Human integration guide](docs/INTEGRATION.md): install, pin, run, read results, handle errors, stream, and use subprocesses.
- [Facade API and quick example](crates/risc-c/README.md).
- [Compatibility contract](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): supported netlists, devices, parameters, and numerical limits.
- [Rust examples](crates/risc-c/examples): netlist, builder, transient, AC, and streaming recipes.
- [Python CLI example](examples/integrate_cli.py).
- [Independent-consumer check](scripts/check_integration.py).

## Validation

- [Validation methods](docs/VALIDATION.md).
- [Recorded core parity evidence](docs/PARITY.md): historical snapshot with a source fingerprint.
- [Recorded coupling/switch evidence](docs/EXPANSION.md): separate scope and fingerprint.
